authorization_semantics.initiation_event: exact zerone-1 successor commitment transaction commits after exact public notice publication
authorization_semantics.if_not_initiated_by_deadline: authorization lapses; publish a signed correction if notice was posted and do not arm or halt zerone-1
authorization_semantics.after_initiation: the exact in-flight F/A/H evidence capture, signer fencing, evidence-derived private archive adoption, and final-checkpoint preparation remains authorized only while the signed plan and preconditions remain satisfiable; public exposure requires a later OPEN-BETA decision

required_bindings: release packet and cutover decision payload hashes
exact notice publication evidence and on-time committed successor transaction hash/height/time
F/A/H and expected A block/post-A app hashes
signer and observer raw-evidence manifest hashes
source observer and fresh candidate public identities
pre-transition sanitized snapshot, rollback log, and pre-transition allowlist-manifest hashes with all future authority artifacts excluded
exact renderer and candidate/final template hashes
exact archive-candidate and archive app/role/config SHA-256 values
deterministic_private_continuation.authority_limit: transition key may sign only the deterministic renderer output for private archive candidate/final adoption; it cannot choose app, volume, image, topology, config bytes, public service, history link, endpoint publication, or DNS

scope_if_go: broadcast exact zerone-1 successor commitment transaction
arm exact zerone-1 F/A/H halt plan
manually fence zerone-1 signer after evidence capture
create evidence-derived inner archive transition manifest
reproduce and sign the deterministic ARCHIVE-ADOPTION-AUTHORITY attestation
deploy exact private archive candidate and final archive only if that attestation verifies
prepare signed final checkpoint without public exposure
initial_beta_exclusions: direct plaintext RPC or REST origins
bridge, claims, automatic issuance, knowledge rewards, alignment, counterexamples, or liquidity activation
